name: claudetto
description: Tunes Claude Code for coding at the lowest token cost, through its official extension points only: settings, hooks, agents, commands, and an output style. It patches nothing.

notificationsEnabled.title: Notifications
notificationsEnabled.description: Use `false` to stop the notification claudetto raises when a turn stops on an API error.

readGuardEnabled.title: Guard whole reads of heavy files
readGuardEnabled.description: Use `false` to let `Read` take a lock, minified, map, or generated file whole. On by default: such a read without `limit` is denied with a hint, since it costs far more context than it gives.

bunRuleEnabled.title: Bun commands in a Bun repo
bunRuleEnabled.description: Use `false` to stop adding a short note naming the `bun` commands when the folder holds `package.json` and `bun.lock`. On by default, since an untold model reaches for `npm`.

maxSubagentStarts.title: Subagent starts per period
maxSubagentStarts.description: The most subagent starts per `limitPeriodSeconds`. Unset: 12. Cap subagents at once with Claude Code's `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS` env setting.

limitPeriodSeconds.title: Period in seconds
limitPeriodSeconds.description: The length of the period that `maxSubagentStarts`, `maxHeavyToolCalls`, and `maxIdenticalFailures` count in. Left unset, it is 600.

maxHeavyToolCalls.title: Tool calls per period at heavy context
maxHeavyToolCalls.description: The most tool calls inside the period while the context is heavy. A call past the cap is held. Left unset, it is 20.

heavyContextTokens.title: Heavy context in tokens
heavyContextTokens.description: The input tokens of the last response from which the context counts as heavy. Left unset, it is 400000.

agentMaxMinutes.title: Minutes a subagent may run
agentMaxMinutes.description: How long a subagent may run before each further tool call it makes is refused and it is told to report and end. 0 turns the limit off. Left unset, it is 15.

memoryFreeMinPercent.title: Free memory share that holds new work
memoryFreeMinPercent.description: Below this share of free memory, new commands and subagents are refused until runs end. 0 turns it off. Left unset, it is 20.

maxIdenticalFailures.title: Identical failures before a refusal
maxIdenticalFailures.description: How many times the same call fails with the same error before an identical retry is refused. Left unset, it is 3.

hygieneEnabled.title: Session hygiene
hygieneEnabled.description: Use `false` to run no sweep at session start. On by default: it removes old temp folders and build folders `trash.toml` or Mole's `purge_paths` names, then runs `mo clean` without a prompt.

sessionTempCleanupPeriodDays.title: Session temp retention in days
sessionTempCleanupPeriodDays.description: The age in days from which hygiene removes the temp folder of a session that is not running. Use 0 to keep them all. Left unset, it follows `cleanupPeriodDays`.

probeCleanupPeriodMinutes.title: Idle temp entry retention in minutes
probeCleanupPeriodMinutes.description: Minutes with no change after which hygiene removes an entry of Claude Code's temp folder that no process holds open. `0` keeps them all. Unset: 60.

trashCleanupPeriodDays.title: Build trash retention in days
trashCleanupPeriodDays.description: Days after which hygiene removes a build folder `trash.toml` names in another checkout, once nothing in it or its git index changed and no process holds it. `0` keeps all. Unset: 7.

protectedPaths.title: Walled-off paths
protectedPaths.description: Folders no session may read, list, or search by any tool or command; each start warns when `permissions.deny` lacks `Read(<path>/**)`, which `/claudetto:setup` writes. Default: the held-out eval set.

openItemsCheckEnabled.title: Open items at Stop
openItemsCheckEnabled.description: Use `false` to skip the Stop check. On by default: a reply that defers work or ends on an offer is sent back once, unless each item names a blocker: a `! <command>`, a denial, or a question.
